hereHead: You are here: 0.1.0 published on GitHub 2026-09-05 (v0.1.0, 43e090b); the user solo-smokes it, fixes go to 0.1.1, first friend test on 0.1.1; outstanding: two-instance smoke for the launcher and the fix passes, the listing URL and the Ziggurat test start (Phase 23), then Phase 19 sign-off
here: 0.1.0 is published. Tag v0.1.0 on 43e090b, 3005 tests green, coop-0.1.0.zip attached at releases/tag/v0.1.0 (2026-09-05). It is a full release, not a prerelease, because the launcher update check reads releases/latest. The Ziggurat test start shipped in it on purpose. The user runs the solo smoke list against this zip (fresh install from the archive, launcher-driven two-instance session, reconnect mid-purchase, save and resume, one tunnelled WAN run); what it catches is fixed into 0.1.1, and the first session with a second real player happens on 0.1.1. Outstanding for V1. Phase 31, the coop launcher, is built (5cc5303: dark FlatLaf window, invite string with seed and world settings, install checks incl. the game version, host pre-flight and guest test connection, bug-report zip, update check, every -Dcoop flag in Advanced, COOP-GAME refusal). Its two-instance smoke is deferred (user, 2026-09-03) and runs as part of the Phase 19 checklist; until then the sandbox's acceptance of System.setProperty for the republished launcher flags is unverified in-game. A second fix pass merged 2026-09-04 (755b587, 2787 tests green): its reconnect message-loss fix, the guest saturation-bombardment deciv, stable-location construction (ticked in the plan since 2026-06-10 but never built) and guest gate scanning are unit-verified only and need the same session, as does the mission-board claim trigger merged later the same day (b8b8e4b): the first-come arbitration had no trigger since Phase 12c, so both players could accept the same bar offer. A third pass the same evening (7d7e553, 2943 green) closed nine review findings, one of them a P0 in the reconnect grace (replacement-socket traffic tagged as the dead partner's); its four smoke items are listed under ATTENTION. A fourth pass on 2026-09-05 (8f66a8b, 2966 green) closed four more: the transport now holds session traffic from an unproven replacement socket, guest storage and black-market trades no longer land on the host's open market, post-battle mirror freezes expire on a per-frame clock, and NPC CR/hull reach the guest through a rate-limited health resend; its three smoke items are listed under ATTENTION. A fifth pass the same day (2641e0d, 2993 green) closed four of seven review findings: a failed colony-management apply no longer rolls the partner's edit back, launcher file writes are atomic, the bridge client stops replaying mutations, and a test pins every message type's policy classification; its one smoke item is listed under ATTENTION. A sixth pass the same evening (67a8844, 3034 green), from a review of every accepted divergence after the release, fixed three: ambient spawns no longer land on a guest in a guest-only system, the guest has no hostile-activity meter, and the Galatia Academy chain is unavailable on the guest; its three smoke items are listed under ATTENTION. The same review specced Phase 34 (bounties for the guest), Phase 26 milestone 5 (sensor ghosts) and two Phase 32 additions (shared hidden-base markets, credit transfer). Phase 32 (shared storage, black market and military submarket) was researched and specced 2026-09-05 on user decisions (all storage markets, no migration) and is next in the build order, before the Phase 19 sign-off. Phase 23 still needs the forum-thread URL for the listing text and the removal or dev-gating of the COOP TEST Ziggurat start in data/campaign/rules.csv. Phase 19, the final sign-off, runs last: the full two-instance QA checklist plus the launcher smoke, with fixes limited to what the checklist fails. Carried over: the Phase 12c manual residue (claim race, sell-back and hire click-throughs, feel pass).

attention.head: 2026-09-05 sixth fix pass: three items unit-verified only
attention.state: open; folds into the Phase 19 checklist
attention.body: Merged at 67a8844, 3034 green, deployed. (1) Ambient spawns no longer land on a guest in a guest-only system: guest parks alone on a jump point 2+ LY from the host for 10-20 days, fleets appear only at a distance, host log has spawn nudged off the guest. (2) No hostile-activity meter on the guest: with a shared colony the guest intel screen has no Hostile Activity entry and no such colony condition, the host still has both, a reloaded guest save stays clean, guest log has hostile-activity event intel. (3) The Galatia Academy chain is off on the guest: guest log has the Galatia Academy story chain is off on this client, docking at the Academy offers only Ask/Leave, the host still gets the provost meeting, and relaunching the guest install as host on the same save brings it back.

attention.head: 2026-09-04 fix pass: six items unit-verified only
attention.state: open; folds into the Phase 19 checklist
attention.body: Merged at 755b587 (2787 tests green, three branches: launcher, net, campaign). (1) A reconnect no longer loses reliable messages — cut the guest's link with a purchase, a colony edit or a salvage consume in flight and confirm it lands after the resume: Coop applying pre-drop type= on the receiver, and no Coop discarding pre-drop for a campaign type. Before this, every drop lost one message outright and the receiver's grace filter ate the rest. (2) A guest's saturation bombardment now decivilizes the host's colony — both engines must lose it, and the next reconnect must pass the fingerprint check instead of hard-rejecting. (3) Stable-location construction was ticked in the plan since 2026-06-10 and never built; it replicates through SPAWN now — build a comm relay on the guest, disassemble one on the host, and expect the objective and the stable location to appear and disappear on both with no OBJECTIVE_OWNERSHIP for unknown entity warn. (4) The guest can scan gates — the "Scan the Gate" option should exist, flip the host's copy to scanned, and let the guest use that gate afterwards. (5) New install row coop-forks.jar matches coop.jar — put an old forks jar beside a fresh coop.jar and expect the row red and coopForksBuild reported in the handshake. (6) Mission-board first-come claiming now fires (merged b8b8e4b; the claim protocol had no trigger since Phase 12c, so both players could accept the same bar offer). Both players at the same bar, one accepts a mission: the other should see it vanish from the bar, read <partner> already took that offer. if they raced and lost, and hold no orphan mission intel afterwards. Watch Coop mission claim requested id= / accepted / rejected on the guest, Coop mission claimed locally id= on the host, and no claim on an offer that merely expired. Known gap: cargo handed over on accept is not rolled back for the loser; historian and commodity offers cannot be rolled back at all (WARN logged).

attention.head: 2026-09-04 third fix pass: four items unit-verified only
attention.state: open; folds into the Phase 19 checklist
attention.body: Merged at 7d7e553 (2943 tests green; nine review findings, all confirmed before fixing, deployed to both test profiles). (1) Replacement-socket traffic can no longer pass as the dead partner's (P0): every inbound TCP message carries the attach generation of its socket, and the reconnect-grace exemption applies only to the generation that died. Cut the guest mid-purchase and reconnect: expect one Coop applying pre-drop type=MARKET_TXN and no campaign message applied before the resume line. The handshake deadline now also drops an unproven replacement that stalls inside the window. (2) The host loading another save no longer makes the guest autosave past it: the guest log must show no coordinated autosave is taken and no coordinated autosave performed for the session-end checkpoint, and the guest's earlier coordinated save must still rejoin. (3) Bug-report zip fails closed on the password: put -Dcoop.password="two words" in vmparams, press the bug-report button, and confirm the packed vmparams has no coop.password at all (or was left out with a line in report.txt). (4) Stale-log version row: touch starfarer_obf.jar's timestamp and expect the Game version row grey (unknown), not red. Not smoke-worthy but landed in the same pass: per-connection throttle trust, queue-cap snapshot resends, failed battle reconciles leaving the applied ledger, the forks-jar identity row reading the jar the JVM will load, and the debug latency lever delaying the release with the claim.

attention.head: 2026-09-05 fourth fix pass: three items unit-verified only
attention.state: open; folds into the Phase 19 checklist
attention.body: Merged at 8f66a8b (2966 tests green; four review findings, all confirmed before fixing, deployed to both test profiles). (1) The host no longer writes session traffic to a replacement socket before it proves itself: the transport holds everything but the connection vocabulary while a session token is set and the peer link is unproven, closing the one frame the pump's grace gate was late. Same reconnect-mid-purchase run as the third pass: expect one Coop TCP holding session traffic line on the host and the held message applied on the guest after its resume line. (2) Guest storage, black-market and military transactions stay off the wire: before this a storage withdrawal was applied to the host's open-market stock. Deposit and withdraw cargo in storage from the guest and confirm the host's open-market stock at that market does not move (not reported; only the open market is host-synced on the guest, no Coop applied MARKET_TXN on the host). (3) NPC CR and hull now reach the guest on their own through a rate-limited health resend (5% buckets, at most one set per 10 s): watch a damaged NPC fleet from the guest for a minute and expect its hull and CR to recover in steps, with trigger=health set sends in the host log. The fourth fix, post-battle mirror freezes expiring on a per-frame clock, has no cheap live trigger (it needs a lost BATTLE_RESULT) and stays unit-verified.

attention.head: 2026-09-05 fifth fix pass: one item unit-verified only
attention.state: open; folds into the Phase 19 checklist
attention.body: Merged at 2641e0d (2993 tests green; four of seven review findings taken, deployed to both test profiles). A failed colony-management apply no longer rolls the partner's edit back: the receiver marked the report synced before writing it to the engine, so a write that threw made the next 2 s poll re-report the stale state as a fresh edit and the partner applied it. It now marks synced only after a successful write, suppresses that market's poll until the write lands, and retries twice. The normal path moved too (synced is marked after the write rather than before), so re-run the Phase 24 management check: toggle free port and queue an industry on each side, expect the other side to follow within about 2 s, and grep both logs for COLONY_MGMT apply FAILED, which must not appear. The launcher atomic writes, the bridge-client retry rule and the message-type policy test need no live run.

attention.head: Phase 31 launcher two-instance smoke now also covers: Fix button, save finder hint, in-game wrong-save notice, getSaveDirName handle resolution
attention.state: open; folds into the Phase 19 checklist
attention.body: Two features landed after the smoke step was written and neither has been in front of a running game. Fix button (Phase 31, 8c22624/3a85328): press it on both red install rows and confirm the classpath entry lands in vmparams with vmparams.backup beside it, that the file is still one line, and that a Starsector update turning the row red again is fixed by the same button. Save finder (f43b63f): save on both sides, alt-tab back to each launcher, and confirm the host's Campaign drop-down grew an entry for that campaign with the folder under it and the seed greyed, and that a re-pasted invite makes the guest's card read Load the save "…". Wrong-save notice: load an unrelated save on the guest on purpose and confirm CoopCampaignGuard names the right one and closes without blocking. getSaveDirName: grep the game log for that name and expect no WARN, which is what says the MethodHandle resolved on the shipped build rather than the launcher falling back to matching descriptors by character and date. Since 755b587 the pick also fills the seed from the chosen campaign, and since 2026-09-04 its sector size and star age as well, so check that the invite copied after picking carries that campaign's three world settings and not the drafted ones. A campaign saved before that date records no size or age; the hint line under the picker has to say so and both drop-downs have to stay where they were.

attention.head: Four bug-audit fixes to watch in the next two-instance session
attention.state: open; folds into the Phase 19 checklist
attention.body: The 2026-09-03/04 bug audit fixed 107 findings; four of them change behaviour a smoke run should look at. (1) The command-tab colony editor is now claimed whole as coop:colony-management: while either player has it open the other is bounced to the INTEL tab and sees "Remote player is interacting: colony management" — the lockout is global, so the second player cannot edit a different colony either. (2) The host's options page should no longer read "pending" for policy values that are not the default. (3) A router that speaks UPnP but not GetSpecificPortMappingEntry will not clear even its own stale entry after a crash: expect a conflict report naming the owner and a port change, not an eviction. (4) The host now learns the guest id and sendTo unicasts, so the N-ready routing paths are exercised live for the first time.

attention.head: Parked Phase 14 fallout (cosmetic/UX)
attention.body: Synthesized customs pursuit reads below vanilla quality (works — chase/give-up/stand-down/catch all pass — but motion is coarser than the engine's own steering); jump-point fleet pop-in near the guest (vanilla's pop-in avoidance is host-relative); and with the two players parked in different populated systems, only one gets ambient spawns (single currSpawnLoc, no-new-fields constraint). D-mod replication for mirrors landed with Phase 16; full loadout replication stays parked. The coarse synthesized-pursuit motion largely predates Phase 29 M1's kinematic drive — re-judge it at the next customs encounter before spending anything on it. Grey-fleet flicker and the unknown-market warn were fixed by 14b. Full list with suspects: PHASE14_SPIKE_NOTES.md "Known issues".

attention.head: Six vanilla classes are forked (pinned 0.98a-RC8)
attention.body: The guest-presence family (RouteManager, PlayerVisibleFleetManager, DisposableFleetManager + two subclasses, SourceBasedFleetManager) plus the pre-existing Misc/procgen forks ride the coop-forks.jar classpath shadow. A Starsector update requires re-extracting each file and re-applying the small additive diffs; the shared runtime guard (CoopPresenceRegistry.getForFork) loudly disables the presence terms on a version mismatch instead of drifting silently. Re-fork procedure: phase11-rng-determinism.md.

attention.head: Ziggurat test start to remove at Phase 23 packaging
attention.body: The COOP TEST Ziggurat start (option 6) must be removed or dev-gated before any public build (Phase 23). The forced tutorial skip and forced Normal difficulty are permanent mod behavior, not dev conveniences: the tutorial rewrites Galatia and Easy's per-client sensor bonus would desync fleet views, and solo play with the mod enabled is unsupported by policy — solo players disable the mod (decided 2026-08-19).
